title: Protection mode - check speaker wires
shortDescription: Yamaha AVR shut down due to speaker short or amp fault.
fullDescription:
Yamaha RX-V and RX-A AVRs display CHECK SP WIRES and shut down when protection trips. Usually a stray speaker strand shorting across terminals.

Older Aventage models could also show this due to driver IC failure but that's rare.

fixSteps.title: Power on empty
fixSteps.instruction: If CHECK SP WIRES clears, rewire speakers carefully.

whenToCallPro: No speakers connected yet fault persists.

faq.a: Aventage (RX-A) uses beefier amps and anti-resonance tech.

title: Thermal shutdown
fullDescription: Yamaha AVRs throttle and shut down when ventilation is insufficient.

title: HDMI handshake issue
shortDescription: Black screen or flicker due to HDMI/HDCP issue.
fullDescription: RX-A/RX-V models with 8K/4K120 support have occasional HDMI 2.1 bugs, addressed via firmware. Also sensitive to cable quality.

faq.a: Minor issues, fixed via firmware - less severe than Denon 2020 models.

title: YPAO calibration failed
fullDescription: Yamaha YPAO (Yamaha Parametric room Acoustic Optimizer) calibration fails on mic issues, noisy rooms, or wrong speaker polarity.

fixSteps.title: Use tripod at ear height
fixSteps.instruction: Mic should be at listening position.

faq.a: Reflected Sound Control - premium YPAO on Aventage models.

title: MusicCast streaming offline
shortDescription: App cannot see AVR; streaming disabled.
fullDescription: Yamaha's MusicCast multiroom platform requires stable network. Router changes, IPv6 issues, or firmware bugs can take it offline.

faq.a: Yes - AirPlay 2 is built-in on most models.

title: Video plays but no audio
fullDescription: Muted, wrong surround mode, or HDMI audio routing issue.

causes.cause: Pure Direct mode with wrong source

faq.a: Yamaha's audiophile mode - bypasses tone controls.

title: Firmware update failed
fullDescription: Yamaha firmware updates over Ethernet take 15-30 min. WiFi drops or power loss during update can brick temporarily.

fixSteps.title: USB firmware recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Download from Yamaha support, install via USB port.

faq.a: Yes - far more reliable than WiFi.

title: Zone 2 has no output
shortDescription: No audio sent to secondary zone.
fullDescription: Zone 2 on Yamaha accepts 2-channel PCM or analog only. HDMI bitstream won't pass through.

faq.a: RX-A8A supports Zone 3; same PCM-only limitation.

title: Subwoofer silent
fullDescription: YPAO may set speakers to Large with no crossover, routing bass only to mains and not the sub.

fixSteps.title: Set speakers to Small
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > Speaker > Crossover, change all to Small.

faq.q: Should I leave YPAO's Large setting?
faq.a: Usually no - setting to Small routes bass to sub for tighter response.

title: DSP program locked to specific mode
fullDescription: Some source formats (Atmos, DTS:X) lock the DSP mode. Cannot override to Straight or Surround Decoder until source changes format.

fixSteps.title: Change source format
fixSteps.instruction: Switch source to PCM to unlock DSP modes.

faq.a: Dolby spec requires native Atmos playback without custom DSP.
